question: What is the primary objective of a computer network?
urdu_translation: computer network کا بنیادی objective کیا ہے؟

correct_answer: B | To enable resource sharing and data communication / resource sharing اور data communication کو ممکن بنانا

A: Only one side can ever transmit / صرف ایک side کبھی transmit کر سکتی ہے
